subject: Request for a Review of My Outstanding Balance
body:
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to respectfully bring to your attention a concern I have regarding my outstanding balance for my residential mortgage. Upon reviewing my recent statement, I noticed an increase in my monthly payments, yet the interest charged seems to have escalated at an alarming rate, which has resulted in a larger outstanding balance than expected. 
Could you kindly assist me in reviewing this matter and provide clarification on the interest rate applicable to my account? I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter, and I thank you for your assistance in resolving this issue.

subject: Re: Buy-to-Let Mortgage - Further Enquiry
body: Hi, just wanted to add I'm planning to rent the flat out on a 12 month AST. Thanks for your previous email, best - John.

subject: Follow-up: Secured Homeowner Loan
body: This is now my third phone call regarding the secured homeowner loan in my name, ref number HS567. Can you please assist me in requesting a payoff quote for this loan as I need to close it out urgently? My loan balance is approximately £22,000.

subject: urgent - can i extend the rate deal on my mortgage?
body: hi, i'm not sure if you got my last message but i'm struggling to pay my mortgage this month. i was wondering if you could help me extend my fixed rate deal as my renewal is coming up soon. it's a real emergency because if i don't extend it, my payments will increase and i don't know how i'll cope. can you please get back to me ASAP?

subject: Auto Reply: Out of Office Notification
body: Hello, this is an automated out of office reply. I am currently unavailable from 24th June until 4th July and will respond to your email upon my return. Please expect a delay in my response and thank you for your patience.
